steps: Schema module jsonl-schema.mjs + reader agreement test
Wire jsonl-guard as PreToolUse on Bash and PowerShell
Prove, commit by path, card ready to merge

log.msg: Census of the main tree (1043 task.jsonl, 33 day.jsonl, 521 page.jsonl): task verbs in use beyond TaskJSONL.verbs are review (942), experiment (114), shots (22, written by Server/review.mjs straight to disk), plus 170 string log lines and ~150 flat lines. page.jsonl is open vocabulary by design (ai2/fold.js: a key it does not know is plain data). append_log writes Servex's own named logs (type-shaped events under SERVEX_HOME), not repo task logs.

decision.question: How strict is page.jsonl?
options: closed key list, refuse unknown keys
open: any key, but the line must be a non-empty object and message/prompt must be objects
decision.why: fold.js treats an unknown key as plain data on purpose, and Servex Cards.js is its writer; refusing would contradict the reader.

decision.question: What does append_log validate?
options: its own kind: Servex event logs, an object with a string type; a verb-shaped task line is refused with a pointer to append.mjs
decision.why: append_log never writes a repo .jsonl; its names are Servex logs, every one type-shaped. Internal Servex callers (Log.append) are left alone so no running writer can start failing.

log.msg: Dry run over the last 3 days of real lines (9953): 930 (9%) would now be refused, all hand-written by agents: log with no at (221), a string log (170), decision with no at (168), experiment without try/measure (29), flat lines (review_reply, answer, landed_at, type:launch). The tools that call append.mjs (Server/health.mjs, Server/task-cost.mjs, Servex/agents/experts-proof.mjs) write shapes that pass.
Servex.js append_log flagged by syntax/spawn hook at lines 729/754: false positive, those are this.agents.spawn (Servex's agent spawner), not child_process. Left alone.

PROOF. (1) append.mjs on a task.jsonl refuses {at,task,msg} flat: exit 3, REFUSED, the right shape printed, file untouched; accepts {experiment:{try,measure,result}} and {review:{found,real,fixed}}: exit 0, 0 bad. (2) node .claude/hooks/jsonl-schema.test.mjs: 30 passed, 0 failed (TaskJSONL, Day, Board verbs agree with the schema; experiment/review/shots listed pending until the reader has them). (3) node .claude/hooks/jsonl-guard.test.mjs: 16 passed (7 blocked, 7 look-alikes allowed incl. arrow functions and 2>&1, fails open twice). (4) Live: after wiring, my own Bash echo '{}' into a scratch .jsonl was blocked by the hook with the pointer. (5) This log was written only through append.mjs.

Not in my fence, listed on the card: node writers that append .jsonl without the schema: Server/plugins/SocketServer/Append.js (the browser's append route), Server/review.mjs (shots, review), Server/decide.mjs, Server/plugins/Ask.js, .claude/hooks/ledger.mjs, .claude/skills/every-prompt/say.mjs, Servex/cards/Cards.js, Servex/asks/Asks.js, and about 20 more (grep appendFileSync + jsonl). Next step: each calls check() from jsonl-schema.mjs before its write.

assign.title: Logs: every JSONL write is checked first; shell appends blocked
assign.outcome:
**Every log write is now checked before it is written, and a shell append to a .jsonl is blocked.**

One schema (`.claude/hooks/jsonl-schema.mjs`) lists what a line may look like in task, day, board, asks and page logs. `append.mjs` and Servex's `append_log` refuse a line that does not fit and print the right shape; the guard hook is wired on Bash and PowerShell. Tests: schema 30/30, guard 16/16. Commits fa238c6a, 66060694, 4f1abcbc, e78cf804, afcad6e5 on worktree/proposal-flow.

Left: about 25 node scripts still append .jsonl without the schema (Append.js, review.mjs, ledger.mjs first); the reader still lacks experiment, review and shots (the verbs-reader minion).
